characters.summary: As an Obscurial, Credence transforms into a massive, highly destructive vortex of dark energy capable of tearing through physical structures and combatting powerful wizards. He relies entirely on overwhelming kinetic force and destructive energy projection when in this form.

techniques: Transforms into the Obscurus, a dark cloud of destructive force
Rampaged through New York City knocking down buildings and overturning cars

mechanisms: Obscurus form dispersed into tatters under massed Auror spellfire yet he survived

weaknesses: A skilled wizard can shield against the Obscurus onslaught
Power erupts when he is triggered and is hard for him to control
characters.formDifferences: The cited source never mentions the "Obscurial Credence" form; variant-specific claims could not be verified and powers are inherited from the base form. (Gemini originally claimed: Transforms from an ordinary human wizard into a volatile, superhuman energy parasite capable of massive destruction and flight.)

Mass havoc in Obscurial form, but a skilled wizard can shield himself from the onslaught.
